**Texere 0.4.0** · 8 November 2026

One plugin instead of four, a guided setup, Help inside Texere, and the words researchers use.

### Major changes
- **One plugin.** Texere replaces Texere · Sources, Texere · Export and Texere · Insights. References, Export and Insights are modules you turn on or off in Settings → Texere → General. Old settings and commands are carried over (see MIGRATION.md). No more Templater and no scripts in the vault.
- **Guided setup.** A few short steps: language, folders, your discipline (Philosophy map), PDF++ if missing, and what's missing in your vault.
- **Help inside Texere.** The whole guide (EN/RO) with a search that understands your own words; Report a problem opens an e-mail.
- **The words researchers use.** References, reading notes, annotations, PDFs, Cuts; folders and notes renamed through Obsidian, so links follow.
- **Flexible folders.** Every folder can be changed from Settings → Texere → General → Folders; Texere follows the folders you move in Obsidian.
- **The Philosophy map** reorganized: Branches, Subfields, Periods, Movements, Theories, Concepts, Authors; its fields come only with the map.
- **New essay** template with contents that build themselves, and **Edit mode** for trying versions of your text.
- **Insights (Lab):** a common layout, simpler measures, projects as a folder, tag or note, and a Debate map that starts a note from any mix of agreements, disagreements and claims.
- **Updates when you choose:** a new version shows up on the home page with an Update button.

Install: download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` into `.obsidian/plugins/texere/` in your vault, or use the ready-made vault at https://github.com/gorgmihai92/texere. Full list: CHANGELOG.md.
